{{Quote|Uh, ''Master Hett!'' I heard that you were on the front lines on Metalorn...''"<br />"''We took Metalorn well over a week ago.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]]|<ref name="Republic 58">[[Republic 58|''Republic'' 58]]</ref>}}
A '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|Though we have had setbacks on vital worlds, we will avenge the defeats on Muunilinst and Metalorn, and strike back with renewed spirit.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Fete Day]] message |<ref name="CIS Shadowfeed Year's Start Fete Day Edition">{{InsiderCite|72|CIS Shadowfeed Year's Start Fete Day Edition}}</ref>}}
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attempted to retake [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], but the Separatist forces were repulsed by elements of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] led by [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Bhat Jul]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|37|Hett, A'Sharad}}</ref>
